name: Lyo.Images.Skia
tagline: SkiaSharp `IImageService` for `Lyo.Images`: resize, crop, rotate, watermark, convert, thumbnails, compression, metadata, palette, batch.
description:
SkiaSharp `IImageService` for [`Lyo.Images`](../Lyo.Images/README.md): resize, crop, rotate, watermark, format conversion, thumbnails, compression,
metadata (optional MetadataExtractor EXIF in the Skia pipeline), palette extraction, and batch processing.

examples.title: Resize with Skia
Register decoration plus Skia

sections.title: Skia compared with ImageSharp
rows: Favours Linux and mobile. Native Skia assets.
Extended EXIF through MetadataExtractor where wired.

Gets the ImageSharp-backed `IImageDecorationService` primitives through `ImageServiceBase`. `AddSkiaImageService` does not register `IImageDecorationService` on its own. Call `AddImageSharpImageService` first if you want that type resolvable separately.

sections.title: Types
rows: `IImageService` that decodes and encodes bitmaps with SkiaSharp.
`AddSkiaImageService`, `AddSkiaImageServiceFromConfiguration`. Uses the same `ImageServiceOptions` / `"ImageService"` section as ImageSharp.
Metric name strings for Skia timing.
sections.trail: Internal helpers (`SkiaExifExtractor`, etc.) are not a supported public contract.

sections.title: Decoration primitives
sections.text: `SkiaImageService` gets the ImageSharp-backed `IImageDecorationService` primitives (`OverlayAsync`, `AddFrameAsync`, `AddCaptionAsync`, `AddOuterPaddingAsync`, plus the `Pipeline(...)` fluent API) through `ImageServiceBase`. To resolve `IImageDecorationService` as its own DI registration next to Skia, register ImageSharp first:

sections.title: Why SkiaSharp
items: Renders natively on Linux and mobile.
Depending on the Skia build, raster formats include JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, ICO.
